description: Perfiles utilizados en los estudios hidraulicos para la determinación de las zonas inundables is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.euskadi.eus. Profiles used in hydraulic studies for the determination of floodable areas. In these profiles there is information regarding the level reached by the avenues of different return period, as well as the flows used. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Profiles used in hydraulic studies for the determination of floodable areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
